verdict.rationale: A community post lists protected branches and code owners as paid-plan features (github-comm-17), which points to GitHub-native merge gating. GitHub Actions is documented for automating workflows in the repository (github-docs-38), and the Copilot docs describe PRs being reviewed for quality and security before merge (github-docs-61). However, no first-party evidence shows that custom checks can be made mandatory before merge. Missing for 10: first-party docs on branch protection or rulesets with required status checks, documentation tying custom Actions or third-party checks to merge blocking, org-wide compliance enforcement, and independent hands-on corroboration.
